channel.title: Mozambique - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mozambique, every source cited.

item.title: Companhia Industrial da Matola challenges import rules
item.description: The Cereals Institute seized 3,300 tonnes of wheat and blocked imports after the company filed a court challenge.

item.title: Mozambique and China advance cassava value chain
item.description: A meeting in Shenzhen mapped implementation of a memorandum of understanding signed in Maputo to boost cultivation, processing, and commercialization.

item.title: Mozambique renews Kenmare titanium mine concession until 2044
item.description: The Council of Ministers approved the extension for the Moma mine, which supplies 6% of global titanium feedstocks.

item.title: Mozambican Banks hold lending rate at 15.5%
item.description: The Association of Mozambican Banks kept its benchmark lending rate unchanged for the seventh month in a row.
